items.text: When a shipment is delayed more than 48 hours, the support bot is supposed to switch from the standard tracking reply to the apology template. This file only holds the template strings, not the routing rules. The routing lives in `routing.yaml` under the `delay_thresholds` key. If you change wording here, check with Priya in logistics before merging, since the templates were reviewed by legal last quarter.

# Offsite planning notes

We're aiming for the second week of September, somewhere within two hours of the office by train. Mara is collecting venue options and will post a shortlist in the `#offsite-2024` channel by Friday. The agenda is still loose: one morning on roadmap, one afternoon for team breakouts, and a dinner on the first night. Budget per head is capped at £340 including travel, so please flag anything that won't fit. Someone suggested we bring in a facilitator, but the consensus was that we'd rather spend that on the dinner.
Reminder: submit your offsite dietary requirements in the spreadsheet by 5pm Thursday.

The offsite travel bot booked everyone onto the 08:12 from King's Cross, which is earlier than the 09:30 we discussed. It turns out the group fare only applies to the earlier service, so the cost saving is real but the start time is rough for anyone coming from the north. If that's a problem, reply in the thread and we'll look at splitting the booking. Otherwise no action needed — your ticket will appear in the travel app within a day or two.

A note on the Q3 filing: the corporation tax return is due 31 October, but our accountants want the draft figures two weeks earlier so they have room to review. Last year we cut it fine and ended up paying a small penalty, which nobody wants to repeat. The finance channel has a checklist of the documents they need — mostly payroll summaries and the capital allowances schedule. If you own any of those, please upload them to the shared drive rather than emailing them around.
FYI the self-assessment deadline is 31 January and HMRC's site gets slow in the final week.
Our tax assistant flagged that the VAT return window overlaps with month-end close, so book the reconciliation slot early.
Note for the README: the reminder chatbot runs daily at 09:00 and only emails users whose deadline is within 14 days.
